title: Ann Connor — A class on Dr. George Marshall
subtitle: Bethel Presbyterian Church, Historical Room — oral history
date_source: The date is written on the physical cassette label, `10.17.71`, as recorded in the archive's working notes, where the digitizer confirms it is a label on the tape and not an inference from a filename. 17 October 1971 was a Sunday, and the tape is a Sunday-school class ("as we saw last Sunday with our communion set", "I gave you an assignment last week"). The one forward-looking date on the tape fits: at 12:10 she says Mr. White will speak "on the 31st of this month", and 31 October 1971 was also a Sunday. The tape states no date of its own and nothing on it contradicts the label. 2026-10-18 is the digitisation date.

provenance.collection: Bethel Presbyterian Church — Historical Room oral histories
provenance.capture_notes: One cassette side, captured as ALAC 48 kHz stereo 16-bit, 1,823.744 s, 44,640,137 bytes, unchanged as received (md5 900a30ad9459a04cbb37fc7e07e04760). Very quiet: -42.1 dBFS mean, about 19 dB below the rest of the collection. The master carries no processing; a loudnorm listening copy exists as MP3 only. The last three and a half minutes are a separate session left running on the same tape.

speakers.label: ANN
speakers.name: Ann Connor
speakers.note: Teaching the class: the historical room's collector, and the speaker for 82 of the 90 paragraphs. Median f0 205-254 Hz across her blocks.

speakers.label: GUEST
speakers.name: unidentified male participant
speakers.note: A male voice at 123-142 Hz: two interjections during the class (a geographical correction and an anecdote about a Westinghouse lawyer) and then a continuous first-person account of his own ministry from 27:05, ending "On May 1st, 1967, I retired." Whether the interjections and the closing account are the same man is unresolved; they share one label rather than being guessed apart.
